hosts.description: List of VPN hostgroups to configure. Each entry defines a remote VPN endpoint and optional authentication parameters.

hostname.description: VPN gateway hostname or IP address (required)

authgroup.description: Authentication group (e.g., 'General', 'Remote-Access') on the VPN server (optional)

cafile.description: Path to custom CA certificate file for server verification (optional)

cert.description: Path to client certificate (PEM format, optional)

key.description: Path to client private key (PEM format, required if cert is provided)

usergroup.description: User group (e.g., 'VPN-Users') for endpoint-specific access control (optional)
